rule: Crop the single large pierced rectangle. Fill each background-coloured hole with the colour that has the most loose pieces of the same shape, matched up to rotation and reflection. If no piece has the hole's shape, the hole takes the rectangle's colour.
scope: Match pierced-rectangle holes to loose polyominoes up to D4 symmetry and fill with the most frequent colour for each shape class.

authored_constraints: The large object is a single 4-connected solid rectangle. Holes keep at least one rectangle-coloured cell between them and the rectangle border.
Holes do not touch each other even diagonally, so each hole is its own component.
Pieces never touch each other (8-neighbourhood) and never touch or enter the rectangle's 1-cell margin.
The background is strictly the most frequent colour, and the rectangle is the largest object.
Piece colours differ from the background and the rectangle colour.
Each hole class has a unique majority colour: competing colours have strictly fewer copies.
Decoy classes are canonically distinct from every hole class, because the library shapes are pairwise non-congruent.
box, holes and pieces must be supplied together. Explicit mode also requires width, height, bg and big_color. bg != big_color.
